ambient/small.reason: Ambient's provider-specific Small tier; models.dev marks it Provider-specific and no listing identifies the underlying checkpoint (its Large tier maps to GLM-5.2), so there is no model identity to link.

unsloth/qwen3.8-27b-gguf.reason: Ambient serves Unsloth's Q4 GGUF quantization of Qwen3.8-27B (unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF is derived from Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B per its Hugging Face metadata); a quantized serving is still that model at Ambient's flat 0.001 rate.
